title: 'Now we all appreciate Costco and Patagonia more. And I notice the mission of companies now and think about supporting and buying from those that care about human flourishing'
summary: A reader who opens by saying she is neither an executive nor a company owner — just a consumer and an employee — describes reading the case studies aloud to her husband and teenage son, and the book changing where the household chooses to spend. One of the few reviews on the site written from outside the boardroom.
blockquote: Now we all appreciate Costco and Patagonia more. And I notice the mission of companies now and think about supporting and buying from those that care about human flourishing.
